title: A screen can hug what it holds
goal: A screen (a frame you draw to build UI on) that arranges its contents in a row or a column keeps the size it was drawn, whatever goes in or comes out. The auto-layout mock gives a frame a size of Hug or a fixed number, and the UI epic is done only when a frame resizes around what it holds. Give a screen that choice on its Width and Height, the same Hug rows a group already has, so dropping a component into a hugging screen grows it and taking one out shrinks it. A screen you drew by hand stays the size you drew until you pick Hug.
notes: Manager review 2026-10-08 of ui-building. acceptance: A screen that arranges its contents (row or column) shows Width and Height with Hug and a fixed number, as a group does today and as ui-autolayout.html draws its Frame size row
With Hug picked, adding, removing or resizing a child grows and shrinks the screen around its contents plus padding, and the change is one undo step
A screen left on a fixed size, and every screen in a saved document, behaves exactly as today (nil stays fixed for screens, so old files open unchanged)
A free screen (no arrangement) offers no Hug, so something hanging off its edge never resizes it

Tests first in PhotonzCore (GroupHugTests or a sibling); a walk at Next defaults draws a screen, turns on Column, picks Hug, drags a component from the Library into it and checks the screen grew, then deletes it and checks it shrank
